title: gfx938 omits existing cast and BF16 contraction admission
executor_revision: bw1100-bench@77a2848f95bd2a13fea0ce69dcc1147ccac39a93; local HCU gateway, not a canonical Lab Executor
observation: The exact gfx938 Target lacks cast and triton.dot.bf16_fp32 although the shared registry, dtype checks and Triton emitter already own them. Retargeted public Schedules are refused before emission. This is target admission, not a missing primitive or a request to weaken the dtype contract. The successor generated three cast routes and four BF16 GEMM+bias shapes; all eleven device checks passed, including reciprocal 2^40 scaling and N=96 tails. Actual native assembly contains the BF16 v_mmac form. A mismatched FP16 contract still refuses BF16 operands.
proposed_change: Declare the existing cast operation and BF16/FP32 contraction on gfx938, add positive and dtype-refusal Corpus cases, and retain a reproducible external-output qualification tool. Preserve the original 180 Corpus expectations and the frozen Ralph Compiler.
principles: P1/P3: existing canonical primitives only. P2/P8: exact target, native instruction and bounded device evidence. P4/P5/P7: reuse registry-owned dtype admission and counterexample. P6: full Corpus Gate and affected contracts.
